name: io.github.Dradradre/honeytokens-as-code
title: Honeytokens as Code
description: Your coding agent plants honeytokens: real powerless AWS keys and webhook traps, with alerts.

environmentVariables.name: HONEYTOKEN_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.name: HONEYTOKEN_HOME
